data.item: COMMENTARY ON THE RESULTS Increased demand for our teas coupled with the weakening of the Kenya shilling resulted in improved performance for the period. PROSPECTS The prospects remain uncertain due to the current inflationary pressures on all inputs resulting to increased costs of production. Weather patterns continue to be unpredicatable casusing uncertainities. G K MASAKI COMPANY SECRETARY SUMMARISED STATEMENT OF CASH FLOWS
